dataset.name: authored-policy-decisions-v1
dataset.provenance: New deterministic policy cases authored for issue #5, not used for prompt or threshold tuning. No model responses consulted during construction. Model-training exclusion cannot be verified.
limitations: Small synthetic policy suite, not representative real-world accuracy.
Related cases share templates; observations are not independent.
Labels are rule-derived by the author, without independent human adjudication.

method: Serial unfused full forward; alternate first order per pair; no prefix reuse.
tuning: None. Dataset and method frozen in Git before model inference.
